title: Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising path for directly generating functionally correct and synthesizable HLS-C from natural-language specifications. However, existing approaches often struggle to turn multi-round tool feedback and reusable HLS knowledge into effective revisions, limiting end-to-end generation success. We propose MementoHLS, an agentic HLS generation framework built around executable and falsifiable dual-memory-guided repair. MementoHLS combines an Executable Repair Contract Library (ERCL), which converts cross-task HLS knowledge into evidence-gated repair actions, with a Reviewer-Grounded Falsification Ledger (RFL), which converts task-local repair history into trajectory evidence to suppress ineffective routes and preserve validated progress. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的HLS生成中的规则引导与轨迹感知修复方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型为直接从自然语言规范生成功能正确且可综合的HLS-C代码提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，现有方法往往难以将多轮工具反馈和可复用的HLS知识转化为有效的修订，限制了端到端生成的成功率。我们提出了MementoHLS，这是一个围绕可执行且可证伪的双记忆引导修复构建的智能体式HLS生成框架。MementoHLS将可执行修复契约库（ERCL）与基于评审者的证伪账本（RFL）相结合：前者将跨任务的HLS知识转化为由证据触发的修复动作；后者将任务局部的修复历史转化为轨迹证据，以抑制无效的修复路径并保留已验证的进展。为确保可靠的结果归因，同一候选评审者将解析、编译、测试平台（TB）和综合（Synth）的结果绑定到相应的候选方案上。
tldr: MementoHLS框架通过可执行修复契约库（将跨任务HLS知识转化为证据驱动的修复动作）与证伪账本（将修复历史转化为轨迹证据以抑制无效路径）的双记忆引导机制，并借助同一候选评审者实现可靠的结果归因，显著提升了大语言模型从自然语言规范生成可综合HLS-C代码的端到端成功率。
en_tdlr: MementoHLS is an agentic HLS generation framework that combines an Executable Repair Contract Library for evidence-gated repair actions with a Reviewer-Grounded Falsification Ledger for trajectory-aware repair, enabling reliable outcome attribution and significantly improving end-to-end LLM-based generation of functionally correct, synthesizable HLS-C code.
